description: Test whether the 56-residue membrane-retained region is a structured heptad repeat rather than the flexible stalk that ADAM sheddases require
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
from itertools import product
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])

# Heptad (coiled-coil) propensity: fraction of a/d positions occupied by hydrophobics,
# scanned over all 7 frames, window 28, compared with the same statistic on shuffled sequence.
HYD=set('LIVMFAWY')
def heptad_score(s):
    best=0; bestf=None
    for f in range(7):
        ad=[i for i in range(len(s)) if ((i+f)%7) in (0,3)]   # a and d
        if not ad: continue
        sc=sum(1 for i in ad if s[i] in HYD)/len(ad)
        if sc>best: best, bestf = sc, f
    return best, bestf

W=28
cent=[]; sc=[]
for i in range(len(seq)-W+1):
    s,_=heptad_score(seq[i:i+W]); cent.append(i+W//2+1); sc.append(s)
cent=np.array(cent); sc=np.array(sc)

rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=[]
arr=np.array(list(seq[27:489]))   # ectodomain composition
for _ in range(500):
    sh="".join(rng.permutation(arr)[:W]); null.append(heptad_score(sh)[0])
null=np.array(null); thr=np.quantile(null,0.95)
print(f"Shuffled-ectodomain null for best-frame a/d hydrophobic fraction (W=28, n=500): mean {null.mean():.3f}, 95th pct {thr:.3f}")

def region(a,b,lab):
    m=(cent>=a)&(cent<=b)
    print(f"  {lab:<42}{a:>4}-{b:<4} mean={sc[m].mean():.3f} max={sc[m].max():.3f}  above 95th pct: {int((sc[m]>thr).sum())}/{m.sum()} windows")
print("\nHeptad propensity by region:")
region(27,430,"ectodomain N-part (SU-like, shed)")
region(446,488,"membrane-proximal region 446-488")
region(455,488,"C-terminal heptad-repeat candidate")
region(426,445,"cleavage loop + CX6CC")

print("\nTop heptad windows in 400-500:")
w=(cent>=400)&(cent<=500)
for i in np.argsort(sc[w])[::-1][:5]:
    c=cent[w][i]; print(f"   centre {c}  score {sc[w][i]:.3f}  {seq[max(0,c-15):c+14]}")

print("\nProline content (helix breaker):")
for a,b,lab in [(433,445,'cleavage loop + CX6CC'),(446,488,'membrane-proximal'),(27,432,'shed ectodomain')]:
    p=seq[a-1:b].count('P'); print(f"  {lab:<28}{a}-{b}: {p} Pro / {b-a+1} aa = {p/(b-a+1):.1%}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4))
ax.plot(cent,sc,lw=1.1,color='#2b6cb0',label='best-frame a/d hydrophobic fraction (W=28)')
ax.axhline(thr,ls='--',color='#c53030',label=f'95th pct of shuffled ectodomain ({thr:.2f})')
ax.axvspan(446,488,color='#9ae6b4',alpha=.5,label='membrane-proximal 446-488')
ax.axvspan(489,509,color='#fc8181',alpha=.5,label='TM 489-509')
ax.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=2); ax.text(432.5,1.03,'Q432/R433',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('heptad propensity'); ax.set_ylim(0,1.12); ax.set_xlim(1,len(seq))
ax.set_title('Coiled-coil heptad propensity in HEMO: the 446-488 membrane-proximal region scores above the\nshuffled-sequence null, consistent with a structured C-heptad rather than a flexible ADAM-type stalk')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
